newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK BANK SIGNS SUBORDINATED DEBT DEAL WITH EBRD.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK BANK SIGNS SUBORDINATED DEBT DEAL WITH EBRD.

text.p: Slovak Tatra Banka a.s. on Wednesday signed a 25 million mark, 10-year subordinated debt issue with the EBRD, a bank official told Reuters.
The bank will add funds from the loan to its supplementary capital to boost its basic assets, Adela Laktisova, a bank spokeswoman said.
"This is the first time that a Slovak commercial bank has received a subordinated loan, which was approved by the central bank as supplementary capital," Laktisova said.
"After this, Tatra bank's funds for crediting will total more than 1.8 billion crowns," Laktisova said.
She gave no further details on the transaction, but said they would be available on Thursday.
Last month, Slovakia's largest commercial bank VUB a.s. and the major saving bank Slovenska Sporitelna a.s. announced plans to launch subordinated debts.
